author: virgin4life
text_post: I was eating ice cream and suddenly my heart was aching like crazy. I have to say I am a 130 kg fatcel. So I thought I was having a heart attack and I am still not sure it wasn't one because it kept hurting for a couple of minutes and I read online that heart attack pain usually lasts around 5-10 minutes. I had pressure on my chest and left arm and I could clearly tell that the pain is coming from my heart. I had the same pain often before but this time it kept coming back again and again. When I thought I was about to die I was just scared at first. Then I thought: "Damn...My papers are not in order and my mother doesn't even know I have money on my trading account." Then I thought maybe if I die now it is best for me. I thought maybe all my problems are solved in 5 minutes from now. No small dick, no 130kg fatcel, no ugly face, no being broke, no having a shitty job, no being a virgin. You know what I mean...I thought all of that may be over in 5 fucking minutes. Today I am just thinking how ridiculous it would be to die lying on some dirty street like a fucking dog and how well it would fit the ridiculous life I have lived. I think I will be trying to lose some weight now eventhough I still have pretty mixed feelings about dying but I think now I know better what dying feels like.
